branding.welcome: Welcome to Hermes Agent! Type your message or /help for commands.

pairs: Start a new session (fresh session ID + history) (usage: /new [name])
Clear screen and start a new session
Force a full UI repaint (recovers from terminal drift)
Export the current conversation (bare /save shows usage) (usage: /save <json|md|html> [filename] [redact])
Retry the last message (resend to agent)
Compose your next prompt in $EDITOR (markdown), then send it (usage: /prompt [initial text])
Back up N user turns and re-prompt (default 1) (usage: /undo [N])
Rewind to an earlier prompt to edit & resend it, or fork from there (Esc Esc) (usage: /rewind [N | fork N])
Set a title for the current session (usage: /title [name])
Hand off this session to a messaging platform (Telegram, Discord, etc.) (usage: /handoff <platform>)
Branch the current session (new thread on Discord/Telegram/Slack/Matrix; --here stays here) (usage: /branch [--here] [name])
Show, list, create, or prune isolated git worktrees (usage: /worktree [new [name]|list|prune [--dry-run]])
Compress conversation context (add 'here [N]' to keep recent N turns; --preview shows what would happen) (usage: /compress [here [N] | focus topic | --preview|--dry-run])
List or restore filesystem checkpoints (restores keep your hand-edits; --all overrides) (usage: /rollback [number] [--all])
Create or restore state snapshots of Hermes config/state (usage: /snapshot [create|restore <id>|prune])
Export a profile (config, skills, theme) to a shareable archive (usage: /export [profile] [-o output.tar.gz])
Import a shared profile archive as a new profile (usage: /import <archive.tar.gz> [--name <name>])
Run a prompt in a separate background session (usage: /bg <prompt>)
Ask a side question about the current conversation without interrupting it (usage: /btw <question>)
Show active agents and running tasks
Queue a prompt for the next turn, or list/edit/rm/move/clear queued prompts (usage: /queue [<prompt>|list|edit N <prompt>|rm N|move A B|clear])
Inject a message after the next tool call without interrupting (usage: /steer <prompt>)
Set a standing goal Hermes works on across turns until achieved (usage: /goal [text | -- <text> | draft <text> | show | gate add <cmd> | pause | resume | clear | status | wait <pid> | unwait])
Set a recurring prompt that re-enters this session when idle (usage: /heartbeat [every <interval> <prompt> | status | pause | resume | clear])
Review this conversation now and save lessons to memory/skills (usage: /refine [focus instructions])
Spawn an independent subagent to review the work just discussed (PR, code, docs) (usage: /review [review instructions])
Re-run a prompt on a recurring interval in this session (usage: /loop [interval] <prompt> [--times N] [--until <condition>] | status | pause | resume | stop)
Write a markdown implementation plan to .hermes/plans/ without executing anything (usage: /plan [task])
Run one prompt through the default Mixture of Agents preset, then restore your model (usage: /moa <prompt>)
Add or manage extra criteria on the active goal (usage: /subgoal [text | remove N | clear])
Show session, model, token, and context info
Show detailed context window view with usage gauge, category breakdown, compression stats, and throughput (usage: /context [all])
Show your slash command access (admin / user)
Show active profile name and home directory
Switch model (session-scoped; --global to persist) (usage: /model [model|reset] [--provider name] [--reasoning level] [--global|--session] [--refresh])
Toggle codex app-server runtime for OpenAI/Codex models (usage: /codex-runtime [auto|codex_app_server])
Toggle a color-coded battery indicator in the status bar (usage: /battery [on|off|status])
Show git changes in the working directory (usage: /diff [staged|all|session] [--stat] [path...])
Cycle tool progress display: off -> new -> all -> verbose
Toggle focus view — show only your prompt and the final response (usage: /focus [on|off|status])
Toggle gateway runtime-metadata footer on final replies (usage: /footer [on|off|status])
Toggle YOLO mode (skip all dangerous command approvals)
Show or set the persistent dangerous-command approval mode (usage: /approvals [manual|smart|off])
Fast mode — OpenAI Priority Processing / Anthropic Fast Mode (normal/fast/auto/cold/ultrafast) (usage: /fast [normal|fast|auto|cold|ultrafast|status] [--global])
Show or change the display skin/theme (usage: /skin [name])
Toggle the 'Hey Hermes' wake word listener (usage: /wake [on|off|status])
Control how messages behave while Hermes is working (usage: /busy [queue|steer|interrupt|status])
Turn automatic pruning of old sessions on or off (usage: /autoprune [on|off|later|status])
Search, install, inspect, or manage skills
Review pending memory writes / toggle the approval gate (usage: /memory [pending|approve|reject|approval] [id|on|off])
List skill bundles (aliases /<name> for multiple skills)
Toggle or adopt a petdex mascot (/pet, /pet list, /pet <slug>) (usage: /pet [toggle|list|scale <n>|<slug>])
Generate a new petdex pet from a description (usage: /hatch [description])
Learn a reusable skill from anything you describe (dirs, URLs, this chat, notes) (usage: /learn <what to learn from>)
Generate or update AGENTS.md project instructions from a repo scan (usage: /init [notes])
Set up an automation from a blueprint template (usage: /blueprint [name] [slot=value ...])
Background skill maintenance (status, run, pin, archive, list-archived) (usage: /curator [subcommand])
Reload .env variables into the running session
Re-scan ~/.hermes/skills/ for newly installed or removed skills
Connect browser tools to your live Chromium-family browser via CDP (usage: /browser [connect|disconnect|status])
List installed plugins and their status (usage: /plugins [update|auto-update [on|off]])
Show available commands (/help skills lists skill commands, /help <text> filters) (usage: /help [skills|<filter>])
Open the fuzzy command palette (also Ctrl+P)
Show token usage and rate limits; `reset` redeems a banked Codex limit reset (usage: /usage [reset [--force]])
View your Nous plan and change it in the browser
Sign in with a Nous account (keeps your connectors)
Show your Nous balance and manage billing on the portal
Copy the last assistant response to clipboard (usage: /copy [number])
Attach clipboard image from your clipboard
Attach a local image file for your next prompt (usage: /image <path>)
Update Hermes Agent to the latest version
Debug report (versions, config keys, error counts; no log text): shows the privacy notice; /debug upload shares links (usage: /debug [upload|nous upload|local])
Exit the CLI (use --delete to also remove session history) (usage: /quit [--delete])
